title: Colour editor and colours on tanks, pumps, dose bars and charts
goal: Doses read at a glance by colour in both themes
acceptance: Setup offers a palette of nutrient-like colours and a custom value
Tank, pump, dose bars and chart series use it; text on a colour keeps STYLE-GUIDE contrast in both themes
A client spec covers the editor; STYLE-GUIDE names the palette tokens
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no Tailscale names, IPs, agent tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
